references.text: Mispah is also mentioned here as a place in the region and refers to the same geographical area in Judah's inheritance.
This passage lists the cities in the lowlands (Shephelah) that belonged to the tribe of Judah, where the verses form a continuous list of cities.
Joktheel is mentioned here as a name King Amaziah gave to Sela after he conquered it, showing that the name was used for various places.
